hypotheses.construction_plan: Define p in {factored, expanded}; define φ_factored(x,y,z)=x*(y+z) and φ_expanded(x,y,z)=x*y+x*z. Each target member is generated as F(φ_p(x,y,z)) with the corresponding p. Distributivity of multiplication over addition equates φ_factored and φ_expanded as polynomial expressions.
required_assumptions: F is single-valued on equal arguments
hypotheses.rationale: The two indexed F calls differ only by the algebraic presentation of the same argument; the latent object is the shared F evaluation parameterized by presentation form, so the outer F structure is unchanged.
